	<ResortReportHeadline>There's fun to be found!</ResortReportHeadline>
	<ResortReport><p>Yesterday's less than ideal weather has mostly pushed through, so it should be a relatively more user-friendly day on the hill.&nbsp; The past couple of days has done significant damage to the cover but there will still be fun turns to be had out there.&nbsp; There is no precipitation at the moment, the current temp is minus 0.6, heading for a top of 3 degrees, and the wind is a stiff northwesterly.&nbsp;</p><p>Sun Run, Basin, Summit and Big D have been groomed and will be in pretty good shape.&nbsp; The Village Loop and Heavenly Valley area have been upgraded to Advanced Riders and Skiers Only, due to a marginal cover and very minimal grooming.&nbsp; Although the cover is marginal, the snow will be fun to ski and ride.&nbsp; Road Runner is scheduled for 7:30 First Tracks this morning.&nbsp;</p><p>Get out there and make the most of it!</p><p>Cheers Bill&nbsp;</p></ResortReport>
